title: GODCHARD ADVENTURE · 哥查德的大冒险

shopCatalog.zhDesc: 【每关限用1次】在本关配发 1 枚高爆破墙炸弹，轰开裂纹石墙与强敌（同关重生不补发）。
shopCatalog.enDesc: [1 Use / Stage] Grants 1 Alchemy Bomb in this stage to blast walls & foes (no refill on retry).

shopCatalog.zhDesc: 【每关限用1次】在本关披挂 1 次能量护盾，弹反抵消一次陷阱或怪物致命伤（同关重生不复原）。
shopCatalog.enDesc: [1 Use / Stage] Deploys 1 Energy Shield in this stage to parry 1 lethal hit (no refill on retry).

shopCatalog.zhDesc: 【每关限用1次】本关激活 1 次大口径烈焰弹：双倍伤害、碎脆壁并打落刀云（阵亡或关闭后本关耗尽）。
shopCatalog.enDesc: [1 Use / Stage] Activates Flame Bullets once in this stage (spent for the stage upon death or unequip).

shopCatalog.zhDesc: 【每关限用1次】本关激活 1 次破魔剑气强化：拓宽剑域、6点伤害并斩出黄金剑波（阵亡或关闭后本关耗尽）。
shopCatalog.enDesc: [1 Use / Stage] Activates Excalibur Wave+ once in this stage (spent for the stage upon death or unequip).

shopCatalog.zhDesc: 【每关限用1次】本关限开 1 次 10 秒黄金金身（按[G]或遇险自动护体；注意：落入深坑依然会死）！
shopCatalog.enDesc: [1 Use / Stage] 10s Golden Invincibility once per stage ([G] or auto-guard; falling into pits still kills)!

shopCatalog.zhDesc: 【每关限用1次】本关激活 1 次灵体穿墙：水平穿过薄石墙与高管且不漏地板（阵亡或关闭后本关耗尽）。
shopCatalog.enDesc: [1 Use / Stage] Activates horizontal Wall-Phase once in this stage (spent upon death or unequip).

shopCatalog.zhDesc: 【每关限用1次】本关激活 1 次空中连跳振翅飞行能力（阵亡或关闭后本关次数耗尽，下一关恢复）。
shopCatalog.enDesc: [1 Use / Stage] Activates Celestial Flight Wings once in this stage (resets on the next stage).

chapterCgs.zhBadge: 第 10 关突破 · 第一章剧情 CG
chapterCgs.zhEp: CH.1 突破 · 冲出反转迷城
chapterCgs.zhCap: 脚踏呼啸飞弹跃出入门地狱的深渊！墨镜恶猫在全息大屏上气得直拍桌子，连忙启动第二层剧毒炼金工坊，企图用毒菇与重墙拦住哥查德的去路。
chapterCgs.enCap: Surfing a live missile out of Chapter 1! Furious on the holo-screen, the Shades Cyber-Cat activates Floor 2's Toxic Alchemy Foundry to block Godchard.

chapterCgs.zhBadge: 第 20 关突破 · 第二章剧情 CG
chapterCgs.zhEp: CH.2 突破 · 毒火炼金觉醒
chapterCgs.zhCap: 紫毒与骷髅红花在剑锋下逆向炼成高爆破城弹！轰开铜铁壁垒、集齐三色皇家宝石后，哥查德昂首踏入引力颠倒、残影追魂的第三章深渊要塞！
chapterCgs.enCap: Brewing poison and skull-flowers into demolition bombs! With the fortress breached and royal gems gathered, Godchard strides into the gravity-flipped Abyss!

chapterCgs.zhBadge: 第 30 关突破 · 第三章剧情 CG
chapterCgs.zhEp: CH.3 突破 · 飞跃三层要塞
chapterCgs.zhCap: 赛博光翼全面展开，一举冲破三层垂直要塞之巅！远方夜空已浮现第四章「恶意博物馆」与时间悖论神殿的诡异霓虹钟楼。
chapterCgs.enCap: Cyber-wings blazing above the Tri-Deck Citadel! Ahead in the neon skyline looms the Chrono-Paradox Spire and the Grand Malice Museum.

chapterCgs.zhBadge: 第 40 关突破 · 第四章剧情 CG
chapterCgs.zhEp: CH.4 突破 · 击穿恶意博物馆
chapterCgs.zhCap: 镜面折射剑波一击轰碎六大展馆的晶化闸门！机甲巨骷髅在身后崩解坠落，只剩最后十层终极天台王座——墨镜恶猫已无路可逃！
chapterCgs.enCap: A bank-shot sword wave shatters the sixth museum hall! As the Mecha-Skull crumbles behind him, only the final 10-floor Spire stands between Godchard and the Logic Core!

chapterCgs.zhBadge: 第 60 关突破 · 第六章剧情 CG
chapterCgs.zhEp: CH.6 突破 · 信号重新接通
chapterCgs.zhCap: 哥查德与墨镜恶猫联手关闭信号风暴，城市重燃霓虹灯火，然而被封存的根源地址 ROOT/00 自核心深处浮现。恶猫低头坦白：它当年只是被更高权限篡改了指令。
chapterCgs.enCap: Godchard and the Cyber-Cat stop the signal storm. Neon lights return across the city, yet a sealed ROOT/00 address surfaces from the Core as the Cat admits its directives were hijacked.

chapterCgs.zhBadge: 第 70 关突破 · 第七章剧情 CG
chapterCgs.zhEp: CH.7 突破 · 钢铁王冠坠落
chapterCgs.enEp: CH.7 CLEAR · THE IRON CROWN FALLS
chapterCgs.zhCap: 机械统御者在漫天金火中轰然崩解，残存机甲核心投射出通往裂界回廊的立体星图；改邪归正的恶猫郑重交出自己尘封已久的旧管理员徽章。
chapterCgs.enCap: The Mecha Sovereign collapses in golden sparks! Its core projects a map to the Fractured Corridor while the reformed Cyber-Cat hands over its old admin badge.

chapterCgs.zhBadge: 第 80 关突破 · 第八章剧情 CG
chapterCgs.zhEp: CH.8 突破 · 像素之外的世界
chapterCgs.enEp: CH.8 CLEAR · BEYOND THE PIXEL WALL
chapterCgs.zhCap: 劈开双层裂界核心，哥查德透过破碎像素壁垒窥见被删除的城市残层与巨影操纵者 NULL——原来前八十关的一切陷阱与试炼，皆是 NULL 筛选权限的行为实验！
chapterCgs.enCap: Crossing the Fracture Core, Godchard gazes beyond the shattered pixel wall into a deleted city layer and sees NULL—revealing the first 80 stages were an access test!

chapterCgs.zhBadge: 第 90 关突破 · 第九章剧情 CG
chapterCgs.zhEp: CH.9 突破 · 最后一秒
chapterCgs.zhCap: 时间统御者败北，错乱的时间线终于归一。恶猫摘下裂纹墨镜坦白真相：它最初盗走逻辑核心正是为了阻止 NULL 重写世界，却遭到反向劫持。通往根源的大门轰然洞开！
chapterCgs.enCap: The Chrono Regent falls and timelines converge. Removing its cracked shades, the Cat confesses it stole the Core to stop NULL from overwriting reality—before being hijacked. The Root Gate opens!

chapterCgs.zhBadge: 第 110 关突破 · 第十一章剧情 CG
chapterCgs.zhEp: CH.11 突破 · 斩裂发条金角绵羊云王
chapterCgs.zhCap: 百关破晓之后，哥查德与墨镜赛博猫踏入尘封的初代像素沙盒「晴空幻境」，不料风车草甸上的绵羊云竟被改装成了满腹飞刀的发条巨兽！哥查德腾空挥出苍青剑芒斩裂羊角核心，漫天齿轮与玩具短刃化作金星散落花海。
chapterCgs.enCap: Seeking rest in the prototype Sunlit Sandbox, Godchard and his Cyber-Cat are ambushed by a colossal clockwork Cloud-Ram! One dazzling cyan-gold slash shatters its brass gears into starlight across the windmill meadow.

chapterCgs.zhBadge: 第 120 关突破 · 第十二章剧情 CG
chapterCgs.zhEp: CH.12 突破 · 飞瀑水渠的彩虹泄压阀
chapterCgs.zhCap: 古老石拱水渠间，失控的翡翠水管盘踞成多头巨蟒封锁山谷。哥查德踏上悬崖奋力拧转巨型赤红黄铜手轮，狂暴水压化作横跨飞瀑的璀璨彩虹喷泉，败北的水管九头蛇也乖乖缩回清潭！
chapterCgs.enCap: Atop the ancient mossy aqueduct, Godchard cranks the massive crimson-brass handwheel valve—venting runaway pipe pressure into a shimmering rainbow arc across the waterfalls as the Pipe-Hydra bows in defeat!

chapterCgs.zhBadge: 第 130 关突破 · 第十三章剧情 CG
chapterCgs.zhEp: CH.13 突破 · 金色剑弧破尽竹林万象
chapterCgs.zhCap: 阳光斑驳的古树翠竹林中，九尾忍狸宗师布下漫天紫影分身迷阵。哥查德凝神挥出一道炽烈金色满月剑弧，所有幻影分身瞬间化作白烟消散，只剩树桩上眼冒金星的小狸猫顶着绿叶瑟瑟发抖！
chapterCgs.enCap: Amid sunlit oak and bamboo shrines, Godchard sweeps a blazing crescent arc of golden blade-light through swirling smoke, dispelling every shadow clone to expose the dizzy little nine-tailed Tanuki boss on its stump!

chapterCgs.zhBadge: 第 140 关突破 · 第十四章剧情 CG
chapterCgs.zhEp: CH.14 突破 · 云海斩雷神·金梯通圣殿
chapterCgs.zhCap: 万丈飞瀑倾泻入无垠云海，哥查德借浮空木箱疾跃而起，苍青魔剑将身披重甲的苍穹雷云魔神一剑两断！风暴散尽之处，一道晶莹璀璨的黄金光之天梯自云端直通最高处的烈日圣殿！
chapterCgs.enCap: Leaping off shattered wooden crates high above floating waterfall islands, Godchard cleaves the armored Thunder-Cloud Archon in two as a magnificent golden stairway opens upward to the Solaris Sanctuary!

s1FinaleCgs.zhBadge: 第 50 关终极通关 · 终章连续 CG (1/5)
s1FinaleCgs.zhEp: 终章 01/05 · 纯白空房间的顿悟
s1FinaleCgs.enEp: FINALE 01/05 · ZEN OF THE WHITE ROOM
s1FinaleCgs.zhCap: 跨越九十九格炼狱长廊步入纯白空房间——不再被假旗与路牌牵着鼻子走，哥查德收剑入鞘静立冥想，一切虚妄陷阱在绝对定力面前瞬间瓦解！
s1FinaleCgs.enCap: Stepping beyond the 99-tile gauntlet into the pure white room, Godchard sheathes his blade in calm stillness—shattering every illusionary trap at once!

s1FinaleCgs.zhBadge: 第 50 关终极通关 · 终章连续 CG (2/5)
s1FinaleCgs.zhEp: 终章 02/05 · 墨镜恶猫光速滑跪
s1FinaleCgs.zhCap: 天台总控台轰然短路！墨镜歪斜的赛博恶猫举起白旗光速滑跪，乖乖用双爪奉还闪耀金光的【250 逻辑核心】：「大佬饶命，再也不敢坑人了！」
s1FinaleCgs.enCap: Control consoles short-circuit! Shades crooked, the Cyber-Cat waves a tiny white flag and paws over the glowing 250-IQ Logic Core in total defeat!

s1FinaleCgs.zhBadge: 第 50 关终极通关 · 终章连续 CG (3/5)
s1FinaleCgs.zhEp: 终章 03/05 · 250 逻辑核心归位
s1FinaleCgs.zhCap: 哥查德将【250 逻辑核心】重新嵌入天台圣座！璀璨青金光柱直冲云霄，净化波纹横扫整座新哥查德城，所有被篡改的世界底层代码逐一修复！
s1FinaleCgs.enCap: Godchard locks the 250-IQ Logic Core back into the spire pedestal! A pillar of cyan-gold light erupts skyward, purging corrupted code across Neo-Godchard!

s1FinaleCgs.zhBadge: 第 50 关终极通关 · 终章连续 CG (4/5)
s1FinaleCgs.zhEp: 终章 04/05 · 新哥查德常识复苏
s1FinaleCgs.zhCap: 常识重归大地：剧毒骷髅花化作漫天盛放的樱粉花海，藏刀乌云变回蓬松柔软的棉花云，连挑剔的皇家公主与洗心革面的小商贩都齐声欢呼！
s1FinaleCgs.enCap: Sanity returns at last: skull-flowers bloom into harmless blossoms, knife-clouds turn soft and fluffy, and the Princess cheers across the restored city!

s1FinaleCgs.zhBadge: 第 50 关终极通关 · 终章连续 CG (5/5)
s1FinaleCgs.zhEp: 终章 05/05 · 黎明天台庆功宴
s1FinaleCgs.zhCap: 破晓金光洒满新哥查德之巅，哥查德迎着朝阳举杯远眺，改邪归正的墨镜小猫乖巧趴在肩头打盹——感谢通关《哥查德的大冒险》全部 50 关！
s1FinaleCgs.enCap: Golden dawn breaks over Neo-Godchard as Godchard toasts the sunrise with the reformed Cyber-Cat purring on his shoulder. Thank you for conquering all 50 stages!

s2Post50Cgs.zhBadge: 第 50 关隐藏片尾 · 根源异变信号
s2Post50Cgs.zhEp: 片尾彩蛋 · 核心深处的 ROOT/00
s2Post50Cgs.zhCap: 黎明庆功宴的欢笑尚未散去——归位的【250 逻辑核心】内部突然闪出刺目的「ROOT/00」底层指令！墨镜恶猫瞳孔骤缩、笑容凝固：真正操控一切的管理员 NULL 刚刚苏醒……
s2Post50Cgs.enCap: As dawn celebrations fade, the restored 250-IQ Logic Core suddenly flashes a sealed "ROOT/00" directive! The Cyber-Cat freezes in horror—the true Administrator NULL has awakened...

s2Post50Cgs.zhBadge: 第 50 关魔力觉醒 · 魔剑系统正式解封
s2Post50Cgs.zhEp: 魔力觉醒 · 哥查德的破魔圣剑
s2Post50Cgs.zhCap: 逻辑核心向哥查德注入魔法力量，沉睡五十关的佩剑正式解封！现已放出【挥剑按键】与【魔剑图标】，可用剑攻击怪物与穿墙幽影！
s2Post50Cgs.enCap: Facing the awakened Root monsters, the Logic Core infuses Godchard with ancient magic power! His long-sealed sword blazes awake—unlocking the [Sword Attack Button] and [Magic Sword Icon] so his blade can now strike monsters, cleave toxic flora, and pierce wall-phasing phantoms!

s2FinaleCgs.zhBadge: 第 100 关真结局 · 根源覆写 CG (1/5)
s2FinaleCgs.zhEp: 真终章 01/05 · 斩碎虚无管理员 NULL
s2FinaleCgs.zhCap: 纯白与黑曜交织的根源核心室轰然崩塌！哥查德看穿「一切操作无效」的终极谎言，凝聚百关历练的一剑将管理员 NULL 彻底斩碎为漫天无害的青金光屑！
s2FinaleCgs.enCap: Inside the collapsing Root Chamber, Godchard sees through NULL's final lie and shatters the Administrator entity into harmless cyan-gold light with one decisive slash!

s2FinaleCgs.zhBadge: 第 100 关真结局 · 根源覆写 CG (2/5)
s2FinaleCgs.zhEp: 真终章 02/05 · 恶猫交还根源权限
s2FinaleCgs.zhCap: 恶猫主动卸下管理员护目镜，将最后一枚根源密钥轻轻放入浮空水晶终端，永久注销一切篡改权限：「从今天起，这个世界再也不需要高高在上的管理员了喵。」
s2FinaleCgs.enCap: The Cyber-Cat voluntarily removes its admin visor and places the golden Root Key onto the crystal console, permanently relinquishing all override privileges.

s2FinaleCgs.zhBadge: 第 100 关真结局 · 根源覆写 CG (3/5)
s2FinaleCgs.zhEp: 真终章 03/05 · 逻辑核心与根源合一
s2FinaleCgs.zhCap: 闪耀金光的【250 逻辑核心】与澄澈青蓝的【世界根源代码】在中央圣坛螺旋交融，化作贯通天地的双色光柱，将整座数字宇宙的裂隙彻底弥合！
s2FinaleCgs.enCap: The golden 250-IQ Logic Core intertwines with luminous cyan Root Code streams, rising as a twin pillar of light that heals every fracture across reality!

s2FinaleCgs.zhBadge: 第 100 关真结局 · 根源覆写 CG (4/5)
s2FinaleCgs.zhEp: 真终章 04/05 · 万物重归温柔日常
s2FinaleCgs.zhCap: 晨光洒满新生的新哥查德城：昔日的骷髅花化作烂漫樱海，刀云化作轻柔晴云，挑剔的公主在露台微笑挥手，呆萌小机兵们正热火朝天地打扫街道！
s2FinaleCgs.enCap: Morning sunlight bathes restored Neo-Godchard: skull-flowers bloom into cherry blossoms, clouds drift peacefully, the Princess waves joyfully, and friendly mini-bots tidy the plaza!

s2FinaleCgs.zhBadge: 第 100 关真结局 · 根源覆写 CG (5/5)
s2FinaleCgs.zhEp: 真终章 05/05 · 百关传说·破晓碰杯
s2FinaleCgs.zhCap: 金色朝阳跃出天际线，哥查德凭栏微笑，与把墨镜推上额头的赛博猫碰杯庆功！百关试炼圆满落幕——感谢你攻克《哥查德的大冒险》完整 100 关真结局！
s2FinaleCgs.enCap: As golden dawn illuminates Neo-Godchard, Godchard clinks glasses with his Cyber-Cat partner on the rooftop terrace. Congratulations on conquering all 100 stages!

s3FinaleCgs.zhBadge: 第 150 关大满贯终章 · 晴空传说 CG (1/5)
s3FinaleCgs.zhEp: 晴空终章 01/05 · 光翼破空斩碎墨镜烈日神甲
s3FinaleCgs.zhCap: 曜金浮空圣殿之巅，哥查德展开华丽的炼金圣光羽翼迎着神圣光柱冲天而起，破魔圣剑贯穿初代坑神「墨镜太阳神 SOLARIS」的烈焰胸甲，化作漫天绚烂虹光！
s3FinaleCgs.enCap: Unfurling radiant golden alchemy wings atop the marble sky sanctuary, Godchard pierces the blazing armor of the Sunglasses Sun-God Boss in a burst of prismatic starlight!

s3FinaleCgs.zhBadge: 第 150 关大满贯终章 · 晴空传说 CG (2/5)
s3FinaleCgs.zhEp: 晴空终章 02/05 · 圣坛上的金色初代涂鸦本
s3FinaleCgs.zhCap: 常春藤缠绕的纯白石坛中央，一本古老鎏金画册缓缓浮空展开，投射出微笑粉花、棉花白云、木箱与小猫的温暖手绘全息影像——原来这片田园曾是创作者最珍视的初心乐园。
s3FinaleCgs.enCap: Inside the sunlit ivy-draped marble shrine, an ornate golden sketchbook floats open—projecting warm pixel holograms of the smiling pink flower, fluffy cloud, wooden crate, and little cat!

s3FinaleCgs.zhBadge: 第 150 关大满贯终章 · 晴空传说 CG (3/5)
s3FinaleCgs.zhEp: 晴空终章 03/05 · 暗刀化蒲公英·风车谷重归温柔
s3FinaleCgs.zhCap: 整蛊诅咒彻底消散，湛蓝晴空下的白云纷纷卸下银色小刀，在半空化作金色蒲公英绒球随风飘舞；翠绿水管静卧花丛，红瓢虫与微笑粉花在风车瀑布畔轻轻摇曳。
s3FinaleCgs.enCap: Under deep azure skies, fluffy clouds shed their tiny daggers into glowing golden dandelion seeds over the windmill waterfall valley while emerald pipes and smiling pink flowers sway in peace!

s3FinaleCgs.zhBadge: 第 150 关大满贯终章 · 晴空传说 CG (4/5)
s3FinaleCgs.zhEp: 晴空终章 04/05 · 木箱莓果茶会·繁花山坡大团圆
s3FinaleCgs.zhCap: 繁花盛开的翠绿山坡上，木箱拼成了摆满浆果挞、白团子点心与红茶的野餐长桌。哥查德将佩剑斜靠在青苔石砖旁悠然落座，与公主、墨镜猫和小忍狸共享久违的午后暖阳！
s3FinaleCgs.enCap: On a flower-strewn green hillside overlooking windmills and waterfalls, Godchard leans back against a mossy stone block beside his sword, enjoying berry tarts and tea with the Princess, Cyber-Cat, and little Tanuki!

s3FinaleCgs.zhBadge: 第 150 关大满贯终章 · 晴空传说 CG (5/5)
s3FinaleCgs.zhEp: 晴空终章 05/05 · 150关大满贯·金色夕阳加冕
s3FinaleCgs.zhCap: 壮丽的金色夕阳洒满飞瀑峡谷与远方浮岛，哥查德立于繁花悬崖之巅披风猎猎，身旁的墨镜赛博猫高举闪耀的黄金星冠——向突破全部 150 关反套路试炼的真正勇者致敬！
s3FinaleCgs.enCap: Glorious golden sunset rays illuminate cascading waterfalls and distant sky islands as Godchard stands atop the flower cliff beside his Cyber-Cat raising the radiant golden star-crown—congratulations on clearing all 150 stages!
